scope: Optional-GCM authenticated-abort cleanup and late-transform isolation on Linux; full G0 and feature gates remain open
implemented: Extend real Kerberos public fixture to optional AES-128-GCM with 16/32-byte exported keys and owned/borrowed callers. Preserve confirmed and timed-out authenticated abort LOGOFFs, older-open continuity, same-candidate retry, concurrent binding, replacement and reauthentication.

Extend existing socket observer with independent JCE GCM verification, exact transform extent and inner-session checks, actual-key/nonce tracking across sessions/channels and an oracle-only ciphertext-tampering control. Native credit/MID accounting also covers decrypted frames.

Four new local BC/JCE cases show repeated valid/tampered transforms for a retired session cannot grant credits or affect another session's outstanding work. Production already discards unknown-session transforms before decryption; no tombstone key retention was added.
